C0733.title: Meizhou Jiaoling Police Dismantle Hacker Ring: Insider-Outsider Collusion to Illegally Obtain Data
C0733.summary: In April 2021, Legal Daily reported that Jiaoling police in Meizhou cracked a case involving insiders and outsiders colluding to illegally obtain enterprise data. On December 24, 2020, a Meizhou group company reported that its materials procurement platform had been illegally intruded into and its data accessed and modified. Police found that employee Xu colluded with former engineer Tian and supplier Peng; Tian used a reserved backdoor to remotely access the system and obtain bidding data, while Xu used his position to assist in contract signing and settlement and collect benefits.
